limits: Négret Pounjut and Bouysselet, each: at most 10%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A South West France appellation north of Toulouse, built on the red grape Négrette. Cabernet Franc, Syrah, Gamay and several other grapes are allowed alongside it.
